You will be shown a series of Java code snippets, for which you should determine the output. 
At the beginning of the study, you will be presented with five code snippets which you should read and memorize.
Afterwards you will be shown code snippets in one of two tasks.
You will have 30 seconds for each task.
In the first type of tasks you will have to determine the output of the code for specific inputs.
Once you have determined the output of the code snippet respond by pressing X. 
If you are unable to determine the output respond by pressing Y.
In the second type of task you will be asked to find three syntax errors in a code snippet.
Every time you locate a syntax error, you should respond with X. 
Repeat this until you find all three syntax errors or run out of time. 
If you are unable to find any syntax errors press Y instead.
If you run out of time on any task respond with Z.
